ourStory.title: Footwear Reimagined With Nature
ourStory.lead: We started JUTU with a simple question: why are modern shoes dominated by synthetic plastics and toxic petroleum when nature already offers superior materials?
ourStory.founderQuote: Nature is our greatest designer. By blending renewable wool, sugarcane, and tree fiber, we created the world’s most comfortable walking footwear.

shoeCare.title: How to Care for Your Footwear
shoeCare.subtitle: Keep your shoes fresh, crisp, and comfortable for years with our easy care and washing instructions.

quickTips.title: Remove Insoles & Laces
quickTips.desc: Pull out the insoles and unlace your shoes before washing to preserve the foam bounce.

quickTips.title: Cold Water Gentle Cycle
quickTips.desc: Place shoes in a mesh delicates bag and wash on cold/wool setting with mild detergent.

quickTips.title: Air Dry in Shade
quickTips.desc: Never put your shoes in a hot dryer. Allow them to air dry naturally away from direct heat.

quickTips.title: Quick Spot Clean
quickTips.desc: For minor scuffs, use a damp cloth or soft bristle brush with warm water and soap.
